indexes.name: UX_desktop_v3_supplier_account
indexes.filterDefinition: ([supplier_id] IS NOT NULL AND [customer_id] IS NULL)

checks.name: CK_desktop_resolution_kind
checks.definition: (([kind]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='dispatch' OR ([kind]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='transition' OR ([kind]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='draft')

checks.name: CK_desktop_reservation_state
checks.definition: (([state]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='DISPATCHED' OR ([state]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='RELEASED' OR ([state]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='ACTIVE')

checks.name: CK_desktop_request_operation
checks.definition: (([operation]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='CANCEL' OR ([operation]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='DISPATCH' OR ([operation]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='CHECK' OR ([operation]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='READY' OR ([operation]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='SAVE_CARTONS' OR ([operation]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='PREPARE' OR ([operation]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='CREATE_DRAFT')

checks.name: CK_desktop_workflow_actors
checks.definition: ([state]='DRAFT' AND [sent_by] IS NULL AND [prepared_by] IS NULL AND [checked_by] IS NULL OR [state]='PREPARING' AND [sent_by] IS NOT NULL AND [prepared_by] IS NULL AND [checked_by] IS NULL OR [state]='READY' AND [sent_by] IS NOT NULL AND [prepared_by] IS NOT NULL AND [checked_by] IS NULL OR ([state]='COMPLETED' OR [state]='CHECKED') AND [sent_by] IS NOT NULL AND [prepared_by] IS NOT NULL AND [checked_by] IS NOT NULL OR [state]='CANCELLED')

checks.name: CK_desktop_workflow_state
checks.definition: (([state]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='CANCELLED' OR ([state]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='COMPLETED' OR ([state]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='CHECKED' OR ([state]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='READY' OR ([state]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='PREPARING' OR ([state]) collate Latin1_General_100_BIN2='DRAFT')
